observations: Photo 0 shows one black games console with a three-layer stepped body, the shape of a PlayStation 4 Pro.

The top carries a printed Star Wars Galactic Empire design in black, white and red; 'STAR WARS' is printed on the front edge, 'SONY' is on the top left corner and the 'PS4' logo on the top right corner.
Two black DualShock 4 style controllers with a light strip on the touchpad (second-generation style) sit on top.
A power cable and an HDMI cable are included in the shot.
Top surface looks clean with no visible cracks or scratches at this resolution; ports, underside, back and disc slot are not shown.
The console is not powered on in the photo; no screen, no system information.
Photo carries a 'Posted on Jiji' stamp and a dealer watermark 'GAMEARENAOFFICAL'.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Pro Star Wars Battlefront II Limited Edition
read_from: photo 0 three-layer Pro chassis and Empire print

claims.evidence: Photo 0: three-layer Pro body with SONY and PS4 logos, in the Star Wars limited edition finish.
Photo 0: the top and controllers look clean. Back, ports and underside are not shown.
No close-up of the screws or warranty seal on the back.
No clip of the console running a game for a while.
Ports are not shown and no clip uses them.
Two controllers of the genuine style are in photo 0, but genuine versus copy and stick drift cannot be told from one photo.
No receipt is shown. It would not change the price on its own.

risks.risk: Console does not boot, or the disc drive, Wi-Fi or HDMI is faulty
risks.proof: One clip: power on, home screen on a TV, insert and load a disc game, show Settings > System > System Information.

risks.risk: Hard drive missing, failed or replaced with a smaller one
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of Settings > Storage on the TV showing capacity.
risks.if_unproven: as console without a working drive

risks.risk: Overheating or loud fan from dust or dried thermal paste
risks.proof: Clip of a game running for several minutes with the fan audible.

risks.risk: Controllers are copies or have stick drift or dead buttons
risks.proof: Clip of each controller on the PS4 home screen moving the cursor and pressing every button, plus a close-up of the label on the back of each pad.
risks.if_unproven: as console only, controllers counted as copies

risks.risk: Console opened or repaired, or banned from the PlayStation Network
risks.proof: Close-up of the back screws and seal, and a clip signing in to PlayStation Network.

risks.risk: Photo is a dealer listing photo with a watermark, so the seller may not hold this exact unit
risks.proof: Fresh photo with a handwritten note of today's date and the serial label on the back visible.
risks.if_unproven: condition taken as worst case; agent inspects before money moves

proof_requests: Clip: power on, load a disc game, then open Settings > System > System Information and Settings > Storage.
Clip of both controllers working on the home screen, with a close-up of the label on the back of each.
Photo of the back panel ports, screws and serial label with a handwritten note of today's date.
Clip of a game running for several minutes with the fan audible.
Photo of the UK receipt, if any.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a Sony PS4 Pro in the Star Wars limited edition finish with two controllers and cables, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working. A boot and game clip, storage screen and controller test would raise it.
